استذنبن (form X)
# اِسْتَذْنَبْنَ (istaḏnabna) /is.tað.nab.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَذْنَبَ (istaḏnaba)
# اُسْتُذْنِبْنَ (ustuḏnibna) /us.tuð.nib.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَذْنَبَ (istaḏnaba)
# اِسْتَذْنِبْنَ (istaḏnibna) /is.tað.nib.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَذْنَبَ (istaḏnaba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
